verdict.rationale: Docusign is an API-first SaaS platform with a REST API and an official MCP server, so least-privilege credential issuance for agents is a fair question. However, the evidence pack never documents OAuth scopes, per-integration permission scoping, or restricted API keys. The one related community report (comm-1) describes a single API user being able to reach the entire account's data, which suggests no scoping rather than proving it exists.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can issue scoped/least-privilege API credentials for an agent
